# eventix/cache

> 标签: Simple, cache, laravel, routes

## 简介

Provides caching methods which can be easily used for caching routes.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 7；已收录于 php-v7, php-v8。

- 源码仓库：https://github.com/Eventix/cache.git
